purpose: The W2 capacity grid: k (stage-A candidates) x n (papers after the stage-A reranker), with the chunk budget scaled to the paper count so the two are not confounded -- C = 20n and c_top = 5n. Six points, plus the A1 dense baseline measured separately.
rule: c_top is a filter only where it is below C, which it is at every point here. The grid is pre-registered: the point is chosen by one standard error on nDCG@10, never by which point looked best on the queries after seeing them.
